notes: This 1879 two-column polytonic parliament record has broken line geometry. In 1, 2, 3 and 12-15, half of the random sample, the crop is a cross-gutter line while the label is a short fragment of some other line (e.g. 1 'ἀρχῆς νὰ διορίζῃ τὸν γραμματέα' under '...ἐν ἀνάγκῃ θέλω εἰσαγάγει εἰς | ἑνὸς τῶν μελῶν...'). Crops 4 and 10 show only the bottom half of the text. Other lines (7, 11, 16, 17, 19) join both columns, and almost all anomalous lines (21-40) are full-width crops with unrelated short labels. With about 45% of lines flagged by C and a column-merge share of 0.31, no simple rule separates the few good lines (5, 6, 8, 9, 18, 20) from the rest.
